resources.string: Storage filler
Fills the free space of a storage device with temporary files, then deletes them. Your own files stay as they are.
Choose folder
No folder chosen. Choose a folder on built-in storage or on a memory card.
Folder %1$s on %2$s
Free space: %1$s
Free space: not measured
Kept free for the system: %1$s
Start filling
Stop and delete files
Written %1$s of %2$s
Fill free space?
About %1$s of temporary files will be written to the folder %2$s on %3$s, and %4$s stays free. The files are deleted when filling finishes or stops.
Fill
Delete remaining files
Temporary files from an earlier run are still on %1$s. Connect that storage, then tap Delete remaining files before filling again.
Done: %1$s written and deleted again.
Filling stopped. The temporary files were deleted.
Writing stopped because the storage reported an error. The temporary files were deleted.
Some temporary files could not be deleted yet. Connect the storage, then tap Delete remaining files.
The remaining temporary files were deleted.
This folder is not on a storage device of this phone. Choose a folder on built-in storage or on a memory card.
Writing to this folder is not allowed now. Check that the storage is connected, then choose the folder again.
Free space could not be measured. Check that the storage is connected, then choose the folder again.
There is no free space above the part kept for the system. Free up space or choose another storage device.
Filling is already running.
Fills the free space of a storage device with temporary files, then deletes them
Temporary files from an earlier run are still on the storage. The program stays in the list until you delete them in it.
